top_signals.title: Iraq Deepens October Crude Price Discounts to as Much as $37
top_signals.summary: Iraq’s state oil marketer offered buyers contractual crude supplies for October at discounts of as much as $37 a barrel to regional benchmarks, according to a document obtained by Bloomberg.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: PCE Data Could Spark Improved Bonds Sentiment: Manulife
top_signals.summary: Matthew Miskin, co-chief investment strategist at Manulife JH Investments, says at the moment “every stock on the planet is loved, every bond on the planet is disliked,” and sees PCE data as a potential catalyst for bond investors to step back into the market. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Healey pledges “new age of industrialisation” as Government backs British shipbuilding
top_signals.summary: Two major maritime projects to be part of “new age of industrialisation” for Britain.

top_signals.title: Descartes launches AI agent for global trade data research
top_signals.summary:
Descartes Systems Group has launched an AI agent within its Datamyne trade intelligence platform that allows users to search and analyze global shipment data using natural-language questions.
